entry.title: How To Can Salsa | Salsa Canning Recipe

media:group.media:title: How To Can Salsa | Salsa Canning Recipe
media:group.media:description:
Today we are discussing how to can salsa fresh from the garden using our favorite salsa canning recipe !
Please check out our other channel: Cockeyed Catfish https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCOqW8bBgEqZb6XRKiklnHFw
To become a MEMBER of this channel: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCQKAbZugsNRV7gmxsX83QpQ/join
SALSA RECIPE 10 Cups Crushed Tomatoes 5 Cups Chopped Green Peppers 5 Cups Chopped Onions 1 Cup Chopped Jalapeno Peppers 1 1/4 Cup Apple Cider Vinegar 3 Cloves Garlic Finely Chopped 2 Tablespoons Finely Chopped Cilantro 1 Tablespoon Salt
Mix together in a large stock pot. Bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce heat and boil gently for 10 minutes. Process pints in waterbath canner for 15 minutes. Remove lid. Wait 5 minutes. Remove from canner and allow to cool on a towel.
